definitions.meaning: This is the required verification level for Personal Banking and Fraud Colleagues when adding a support need.

This indicates no verification is required when adding a support need if the customer is unable to give consent (e.g., due to reduced mental capacity or exceptional circumstances), or when the customer is not present (e.g., informed by a third party).
This is a verification requirement for Community Bank Colleagues to add a support need if the customer is present in branch and able to give consent.

This is a verification requirement for Community Bank Colleagues when adding a support need if the customer either phones the branch and gives consent or is phoned by a branch colleague and gives consent.
